title: Pan-Seared Scallops with Egyptian Butter Sauce
description: A keto friendly dish featuring pan-seared scallops in an Egyptian butter sauce. This recipe combines the richness of beurre noisette with the winey flavor of velvety wine.
instructions: 1. Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Pat the scallops dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
3. Add the butter to the skillet and let it melt.
4. Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
5. Add the scallops and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
6. Remove the scallops from the skillet and set aside.
7. Add the white wine to the skillet and let it simmer for 2-3 minutes.
8. Stir in the beurre noisette and cook for an additional minute.
9. Return the scallops to the skillet and toss with the Egyptian butter sauce.
10. Garnish with parsley and serve immediately.
